name: Zaina
source:
"I'm only good at bandaging up people because Finn is reckless, bleeding on things when I'm TRYING to take photos."

Major: Undeclared
Skills: Bandaging, photography, riding a motorcycle

Fearless Motorcycle Babe

Zaina is quite feisty and her patience is always thin, but she's loyal with a fierce protective streak. She loves to take photos and ride her motorcycle! She'd be a very reliable person if not for her tendency to ghost her friends out of nowhere.

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/enamored-risks]itch.io[/url]]
